DND5ESG.Title: Ability Score Generator: {name}
DND5ESG.BonusHint: Bonuses already applied by your background, feats, and class ASIs. They're added on top of the new scores, up to the ability maximum. Hover a bonus to see its sources.
DND5ESG.NoRollsYet: No scores rolled yet. Click Roll Scores to generate six values.
DND5ESG.PointsHint: Scores range from 8 to 15 before bonuses.
DND5ESG.ArrayHint: Drag each value of the standard array onto an ability, or click a value and then an ability. Dropping on a filled ability swaps the two.
DND5ESG.AssignHint: Drag a value onto an ability, or click a value and then an ability. Dropping on a filled ability swaps the two. Drag a placed value back here to remove it.
DND5ESG.PoolEmpty: All values placed. Drag one back here to remove it.
DND5ESG.Committed: You have rolled scores for this character, so you must use the rolled values.
DND5ESG.NoMethods: No stat generation methods are enabled. Ask your GM.

Notify.NotAllowed: You can't generate stats for this character.
Notify.NoRerolls: No rerolls remaining for this character.
Notify.Incomplete: Assign a score to every ability first.
Notify.OverBudget: You've spent more points than the budget allows.
Notify.Reset: {name} reset: ability scores set to 10 plus existing bonuses.

Confirm.RerollContent: This replaces the current rolled scores. It can't be undone.
Confirm.ApplyContent: This overwrites the base ability scores on {name}.
Confirm.UnspentContent: You still have {left} unspent point(s). Apply anyway?
Confirm.ResetContent: Sets every ability score on {name} back to 10, keeping bonuses from background, feats and class ASIs. Also clears the rolled scores, reroll count and applied lock. This can't be undone.

allowRoll.Name: Allow Rolling
allowRoll.Hint: Let users generate scores by rolling dice.

allowPointBuy.Name: Allow Point Buy
allowPointBuy.Hint: Let users generate scores with point buy.

allowArray.Name: Allow Standard Array
allowArray.Hint: Let users assign the standard array (15, 14, 13, 12, 10, 8).

rollFormula.Name: Roll Formula
rollFormula.Hint: Formula rolled for each ability score. Examples: 4d6kh3 (standard), 4d6r1kh3 (reroll 1s), 3d6, 2d6+6.

pointBuyBudget.Name: Point Buy Budget
pointBuyBudget.Hint: Number of points available for point buy. 27 is standard.

playerRerolls.Name: Player Rerolls
playerRerolls.Hint: How many times a player may reroll a full set after the first roll. 0 = no rerolls, -1 = unlimited. GMs are never limited.

rollCommits.Name: Rolling Commits Players
rollCommits.Hint: Once a player rolls, they must use the rolled values and can't switch to point buy or standard array.

includeAdvancementBonuses.Name: Keep Background & Feat Bonuses
includeAdvancementBonuses.Hint: Add ability score increases already applied by background, feat, and class ASI advancements on top of the generated scores, so applying doesn't wipe them out.

postToChat.Name: Post to Chat
postToChat.Hint: Post rolled scores and applied results to chat.

playersCanUse.Name: Players Can Use
playersCanUse.Hint: Show the stat generator to players who own a character. GMs always see it.

lockAfterApply.Name: Lock After Applying
lockAfterApply.Hint: Hide the generator from players once scores have been applied. A GM can reset it from the generator window.
